grammar.title: Second Conditional in Negotiations
rules: "If + passado simples, would + verbo base" descreve situações hipotéticas: If you gave us a discount, we would sign.
Usa-se "were" no lugar de "was" em situações formais/hipotéticas: If I were you, I would accept.
O segundo condicional é ideal para propor cenários de negociação sem compromisso: If we increased the order, would you lower the price?
A pergunta no segundo condicional inverte "would": Would you lower the price if we ordered more?
